items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: But Scoop Carey and them were working. But I'd go down and jam with him.

ctx.x: No, I didn't work with Roy then. But Scoop Carey and them were working. But I'd go down and jam with him. No, I never did really work with Roy in Chicago

because this was after Roy was with Fletcher in Chicago that he got this little group of his own going over there. He and Chu were with Fletcher out in Chicago, Chu Berry. I didn't work with him. No, I just jammed with him out there. Like I didn't work with Albert Ammons but I jammed with him.
